## Summary

Kuno von Liebenstein, komtur of Osterode and godfather of Danutė, is the Order's informant who warned [Kęstutis](kestutis.qmd) of the secret treaty of [Dovydiškės](../events/ev_dovydiskes.qmd) in August 1381. He is named in Book I ch. 1.

## Record vs saga

- **[Record]:** Ivinskis (1978), followed by the English Wikipedia (Civil War 1381-84; Treaty of Dovydiškės): Kuno von Liebenstein, komtur of Osterode, in August 1381. VLE and Wigand name no informant, so the name is one of several versions (`books/sources.qmd`). Not to be confused with Kuno von Lichtenstein, the Grand Commander killed at Grunwald.
- **[Saga invention]:** Nothing beyond the warning; the saga keeps the historical informant and does not turn him into a character of the Book VI cast.
